summary: Recorded OWNER-BATTERY-TESTNET-01 (OD-1 to OD-8) and OWNER-BATTERY-TESTNET-02 (research-time battery vocabulary: JAX-only validation, no Burgers edits, excluded items stay excluded) and delivered M1 of the battery testnet track. Construction contracts are now per Challenge: one registry and one B-02B compiler, but each Challenge version has its own ChallengeContract (capabilities, surfaces and ranges, declared envelope, lanes) pinned by its own contract digest. Burgers keeps its vocabulary and its research and session contract identities byte for byte; by owner direction its GPU diagnostic lane now offers every rebuildable Burgers family (catalog v2; GPU hardware acceptance of the added families not claimed). The non-paying DEVELOPMENT Challenge carbon.battery-fastcharge-ageing-development.v1 answers every one of the 92 reviewed capabilities: 49 are rebuildable in JAX (kNN, MLP and a battery DeepONet; all eleven optimizers and eight learning-rate curves; minibatches, extra trajectory losses, L-BFGS polish, ensembles, EMA and tail averaging, float64, TRAIN subsets, important-region weighting, curriculum and hard-example weighting), the rest are research-only with recorded reasons or excluded (non-JAX backends, PyBaMM label reuse, and the five declarative exclusions). The campaign recipes stay bit-identical to the research recipes. Every Challenge's admission refuses an unknown Challenge, family or field by name, a Burgers family under battery and the reverse, an ignored or contradictory field, and a contract-digest mismatch; the digest is recorded in check-design and every frozen-candidate record. No exam, scoring rule, threshold, chain action, spend or qualification changes.
